mapper.select: SELECT DOCUMENT_ID, STATENO, FNAME, MNAME, LNAME, SSN, DOB_TEXT, SUFFIX, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_CITY, ADDRESS_STATE, ADDRESS_ZIPCODE, ADDRESS_PLUS4, COUNTY_FIPS, HOME_PHONE, ADDRESS_TRACT_CENSUS, TRACT_SUFFIX_CENSUS, ADDRESS_LATITUDE, ADDRESS_LONGITUDE, PKG_TRK_COMMON.fn_get_fullname(users.LAST_NAME ,users.FIRST_NAME ,users.MIDDLE_NAME , NULL) CREATEID, CREATEDT FROM TRACKING_USER_ENTERED_ADDRESS address, NYEHMS_USERS users where DOCUMENT_ID=#{documentId} AND address.CREATEID = users.LEGACY_UID(+) and rownum < 2

SELECT DOCUMENT_ID, ALIAS_ID, STATENO, REPSRCCD, ALIAS_NO, FNAME, MNAME, LNAME, SSN, DOB_TEXT, DOB, SUFFIX, PKG_TRK_COMMON.fn_get_fullname(users.LAST_NAME ,users.FIRST_NAME ,users.MIDDLE_NAME , NULL) CREATEID, CREATEDT, UPDATE_UID, UPDATE_DT, COMMENTS FROM TRACKING_USER_ENTERED_ALIAS alias, NYEHMS_USERS users where DOCUMENT_ID=#{documentId} AND alias.CREATEID = users.LEGACY_UID(+) and rownum < 2
